{{- /* creator/card.html — single card partial (arch/26 §3). Input: (dict "node" "kind" "auto|row|folder|mini" "showSec" true) auto → Essay card when the node has a card image, Note card otherwise row → home section row (icon 22 + title + relative time) folder → sub-folder card (icon + title + desc + count) mini → backlink card (icon + title + one-line desc) Whole card is the link. data-growth / data-date / data-section on every card. */ -}} {{- $n := .node -}} {{- $kind := .kind | default "auto" -}} {{- $showSec := .showSec | default true -}} {{- $label := $n.title -}} {{- if and (not $n.hasTitle) $n.fdateText -}}{{- $label = $n.fdateText -}}{{- end -}} {{- if eq $kind "folder" -}} {{ partial "creator/folder-icon.html" (dict "node" $n "size" 24) }} {{ $n.title }} {{- with $n.desc }}{{ . }}{{ end }} {{ $n.n }} {{ cond (eq (printf "%v" $n.n) "1") "note" "notes" }} {{- else if eq $kind "row" -}} {{- partial "creator/growth-icon.html" (dict "stage" $n.growth "size" 22) -}} {{ $label }} {{- partial "creator/dates.html" (dict "iso" $n.date "text" $n.dateText "rel" true) -}} {{- else if eq $kind "mini" -}} {{- partial "creator/growth-icon.html" (dict "stage" $n.growth "size" 20) -}} {{ $label }} {{- with $n.desc }}{{ . }}{{ end }} {{- else if $n.cover -}} {{ $label }} {{- with $n.desc }}{{ . }}{{ end }} {{- if and $showSec $n.sec }}{{ $n.sec }}{{ end -}} {{- partial "creator/growth-icon.html" (dict "stage" $n.growth "size" 15) -}} {{- partial "creator/dates.html" (dict "iso" $n.date "text" $n.dateText "rel" true) -}} {{- else -}} {{ partial "creator/growth-icon.html" (dict "stage" $n.growth "size" 24) }} {{ $label }} {{- with $n.desc }}{{ . }}{{ end }} {{- if and $showSec $n.sec }}{{ $n.sec }}·{{ end -}} {{- partial "creator/dates.html" (dict "iso" $n.date "text" $n.dateText "rel" true) -}} {{- end -}}
